review: The136 authenticated-definer WARN findings include admin_auth_ip_observations, intentionally callable by authenticated but guarded by current active Admin/Master checks. Fresh deployed IP8/8 actual-role checks now pass: Admin minimal reader/repeated request/literal search, Finance/member/anonymous denial. Deployed page0of0retained observations is visually verified; actual Refresh-button interaction remains pending and is not inferred from API tests. Eleven private no-policy RLS INFO findings deliberately deny app-role direct table reads/writes; the two new tables are Aadhaar verification sessions and Google coordinate cache, with service-only access boundaries tested. One additional WARN records leaked-password protection disabled, giving137 WARN total;0 ERROR does not mean no warnings or universal security certification. No broad grants or weakened protections added.
